{"observation": "Both configurations completed with identical data hashes, split hash and 14 listed source inputs; duration and campaign are excluded, and no derived features are listed. Forest-minus-logistic mean fold differences are +0.02824 AP, −0.00394 ROC-AUC, −0.00077 Brier and −0.00761 log loss. Forest AP improves in five of six paired folds, AUC declines in four, Brier improves in four and log loss improves in all six. Reported repeat AP increases are +0.03025 and +0.02623; Brier and log loss decrease in both reported repeats. However, these repeat summaries appear to average fold metrics rather than evaluate concatenated out-of-fold predictions. Logistic balance masking improves AP and AUC in five of six folds and Brier/log loss in all six. Forest balance masking improves AUC in four folds, but AP, Brier and log loss each improve in only three. Separately masking pdays or previous worsens forest Brier in every fold; complete history loss was not tested. Clean calibration shows range-specific discrepancies: forest predictions in the 0–0.2 bin slightly exceed observed frequencies in both repeats, whereas its 0.4–0.6 bin underpredicts substantially (0.502 versus 0.711, n=45; 0.500 versus 0.738, n=42). Logistic predictions overpredict in that same range (0.492 versus 0.371 and 0.498 versus 0.429; n=35 each). Reported runtimes are approximately 0.67 and 2.70 seconds.", "interpretation": "The forest offers a descriptive AP/probability-quality improvement with an AUC trade-off, not universal superiority. Its reported repeat summaries satisfy the directional improvement rule, but the prespecified criterion remains unverified until AP is calculated from complete out-of-fold predictions separately by repeat. Fold direction counts do not establish significance. The logistic balance-masking result is a useful negative finding about the fitted raw-balance contribution under this absence proxy. Together with the skewed balance profile, it motivates the nominated signed-log representation test, but does not predict that transformation will succeed. Forest balance-masking results are mixed, and its positive single-fold balance permutation AUC drop of 0.00989 further cautions against declaring balance useless. Neither lower Brier/log loss nor these calibration bins establish uniformly better calibration: the forest has substantial upper-range underprediction, while logistic regression has upper-range overprediction. Separate history stresses cannot establish tolerance to complete history absence while poutcome remains available.", "limitations": ["Repeat AP and AUC summaries appear to be fold averages, despite the requested pooled out-of-fold evaluation. Row-level predictions are not supplied here, so the intended repeat-level endpoints cannot be verified.", "Exact replacement values, fitted preprocessing parameters, nominal encoding, complete estimator settings, convergence records and training-fold prevalence reference results are absent. Source lists support feature exclusion but do not fully audit preprocessing leakage.", "Joint pdays/previous/poutcome masking, combined balance-plus-history masking, repeat-level stressed metrics and stressed calibration remain missing. Forest empty calibration bins are omitted rather than explicitly marked.", "Calibration upper bins are small, including only five forest predictions in the second repeat's 0.6–0.8 bin. Repeated predictions concern the same 2,000 rows and approximately 200 positives, not independent samples.", "All comparisons reuse adaptive development CV. Overlapping folds and repeats provide neither an independent test nor confidence intervals; matching historical scores are not independent replication.", "Duplicate grouping does not establish customer or temporal independence. Point-in-time availability, prior-outcome semantics, legacy category mappings and the 31-valued day_of_week field remain unresolved.", "Frozen-model masking tests a replacement proxy, not retraining without inputs or verified operational missingness. Freeze this critique and use the one remaining configuration only for that intervention. Before fitting, validate finite negative/zero/positive transformations, training-fold-only preprocessing, explicit imputation/transformation order and source-mask propagation. Obtain genuinely pooled out-of-fold metrics per repeat for all configurations, then compare signed-log versus its logistic parent using paired fold deltas and the prespecified rule: AP increases in both repeats and mean Brier/log loss do not worsen, with AUC trade-offs disclosed.
